name: dsh-full-character-v012-replication

rules: Fresh Lab node and clean context per step and retry
Clone the tag and verify the full commit in every geometry Lab
Reuse repository modules and tests; incremental step patches only
One geometry job per Lab; consume predecessor artifact
Flow completion first; intermediate handoff gates only; final quality acceptance later
Original project and all unrelated projects read-only
Convergence candidate frozen; no further mouth-shell experiments

NODE_TYPE_SECTION.name: Base body front and side references

params.prompt: 基于参考图中的角色身份、轮廓、比例和关键结构，生成一张完整清晰的角色正面 T-Pose 图片，双臂平举，站姿自然，身体与服装结构完整可辨。细节干净、层次分明。排除挂载的服饰，比如飘带、披风、吊坠等，直接基于参考图生成。不要出现元素糊在一起的画面。写实风格，干净简洁背景，均匀柔和灯光，避免遮挡、裁切和模糊。

Create one complete full-body front T-pose of this same blue-haired anime character, arms horizontal, original face identity, blue bob hairstyle and star, costume details and proportions preserved. Clean flat anime colors, continuous line work, plain neutral background, even light, uncropped body and limbs. No extra views, no text.

Create one complete bald base-body T-pose preserving the reference character proportions. Fitted separate white bandeau and underwear, full body front, clean anatomy and plain background. No hairstyle or accessories. Keep facial features recognizable. This is a body base, not a head-only model.

Create the character costume as a headless clothed body from clavicle to toes in a front T-pose. Preserve the reference outfit, proportions, sleeves, gloves, legwear and shoes. Plain background, clean flat anime colors, no floating accessories or hair.

Create one hairless head-only close-up of this same anime character. Complete bald scalp, both ears, full facial features, eyes with original iris colors, nose, mouth, chin and short neck. No hair, fringe, wig, star, body or shoulders. Preserve original facial identity and proportions. Front view, flat palette, clean continuous line work and plain background.

Create only the character blue bob hairstyle and its original star accessory as a separate headless wig asset. Keep the original hairstyle silhouette, fringe, side locks, blue color and star placement. Remove all head, face, eyes, ears, neck, body and skin. One three-quarter front view, plain neutral background, clean anime surface.

steps.prompt: Prepare the body-sm artifact as the body assembly base. Normalize consistent meters and character axes, keep its shape and texture, remove only isolated obvious debris if needed. Reuse research_stages/topology_core.py for finite/topology observations and baseline helpers as appropriate. Save semantic Body and source-part metadata for following Labs. This job is body preparation only. Publish body-prepared.glb, editable BLEND and small handoff JSON; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Fit clothes-sm to body-prepare and assemble clothing with the prepared body. Preserve clothing design and texture; remove duplicate clothed-source head/skin only where clearly redundant. Match body scale/pose using measured landmarks; a usable fit is sufficient. Preserve prior semantic parts. Reuse repository components/topology helpers with an incremental alignment adapter. Do not do head, rig or anatomy work. Publish clothed-body.glb, editable BLEND and small handoff JSON; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Fit the genuine hairless-head-sm to the clothed-body predecessor. Replace the predecessor temporary head with this hairless head, preserving face identity, hairless scalp, textures and all clothing/body parts. Align scale, axes and neck using measurements. Use repository head_helpers and head_subset helpers as baseline, with an incremental registration adapter for SM. Do not build hair, eyes or mouth in this step. Publish head-assembled.glb, BLEND and handoff JSON; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Fit the separate wig-sm onto the hairless head in head-fit. Keep wig independent from head, preserve star and material identity. Use measured scalp landmarks and bounded affine/registration fit. Preserve all prior body/clothes/head geometry. Reuse repository components helpers and topology observations with incremental fitting code. This job is hair fitting only. Publish hair-assembled.glb, BLEND and handoff JSON; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Add stationary eyeballs and left/right blink controls to the rigged predecessor. Use v0.1.2 head_repair/eye_plan.py and eyes.py, plus lab_recipes/lid_surface.py as the measured-aperture surface baseline. The source is SM, so derive a new profile/coordinates from actual face landmarks; do not apply old hard-coded original-character indices. Adapt only input mapping, preserve body/clothes/hair/rig and appearance. A workable exported blink with real eyelid geometry is the handoff goal; record remaining visual defects without an unbounded repair loop. Keep native iris colors/textures where possible. Publish eyes-blink.glb, BLEND, control_manifest.json and profile/patch evidence; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Add a jaw bone and bounded mouth opening controls to the preceding character, preserving existing eyes/blinks/rig/body/clothes/hair. Start from head_workflow/stages/build_jaw_mouth.py and head_repair/controls.py, with incremental SM input/profile adaptation. Use 8-degree jaw range for this first reproduction. Retain a usable existing mouth; do not run another broad mouth-shell experiment or chase a 15-degree large-gap volume. If simple lining/teeth/tongue are necessary for an actual mouth control, use the repository stage narrowly. Record known limits. Publish jaw-controls.glb, BLEND, embedded/control manifest and patch; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Expose and verify a minimal usable set of expression controls on jaw-controls. Preserve existing blinks and jaw, add/transfer smileLeft, smileRight, browRaiseLeft, browRaiseRight, browFrownLeft, browFrownRight and mouthPucker using the repository expression stage and head_repair/controls.py as baseline. Use incremental SM mapping. Controls must actually deform relevant geometry; do not satisfy the step with empty named morphs. Export morphs/weights, record exact reset and a compact actual movement table. No broad anatomy repair. Publish expression-controls.glb, BLEND, control manifest and patch; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Consolidate the predecessor appearance for a coherent flat-palette anime character while preserving its actual joints/morphs/weights. Keep original iris appearance and continuous line work; retain good generated textures. Reuse head_repair/appearance.py or repository material helpers with incremental SM material mapping. Do not regenerate geometry or install external asset data. This step is material/texture consolidation only; document unchanged textures where they already work. Publish textured-character.glb, BLEND and material handoff; GLB last and exactly one primary model.

Export the final character from the previous texture-consolidate artifact, reimport the actual GLB, and validate it with repository GLB tests plus finite positions/weights, nonempty geometry, joints and actual morphs. Preserve all parts and controls. Produce character.glb and editable character.blend, control_manifest.json, compact recipe/patch/handoff report, source hashes and matched front/oblique neutral and blink renders. Report measured passes and known limitations separately; quality acceptance follows this first completed chain. Do not repair or generate new geometry. Publish exactly one primary model GLB last, marked final.

labPreamble: This is one fresh Lab step in the operator-authorized clean canvas replication. Clone https://github.com/baitouwuya/dsh-head-workflow.git --branch v0.1.2 --depth 1 into a new directory before geometry work. Verify HEAD is d426943ec20fb224dc0f2e2052019049c0a7196f and record it. Run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v and node --test tests/verify-glb.test.cjs; standard tools including Blender 5.x may be installed if needed. Reuse repository stages and tests, with only incremental patches for this step; preserve the patch. Do not rewrite the workflow or run the entire repair pipeline for a single step. Download no external model/texture assets. Consume the attached predecessor, do exactly the named job, then hand one primary GLB to the next Lab. Preserve useful mesh/rig metadata and embed a small JSON manifest in GLB extras if following steps need it. Publish a single primary model to Studio and make sure it is the final selected result; publish reports/BLEND before the model. Input/output hashes, actual nonempty finite export and a narrow handoff report are required. Missing measurements are missing, never zero. Usable intermediate quality is sufficient; no unbounded perfection loops. The frozen convergence deliverable is unchanged. No graph/account changes, deletion or public sharing.
